name: oak-observatory-monorepo
description: Standalone, git-free, per-edit Keep/Undo for Claude Code on established and mission-critical codebases — terminal, VS Code and JetBrains, zero extra tokens.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @oak-observatory/core && npm run build -w @oak-observatory/tui && npm run build -w oak-observatory && npm rebuild oak-observatory --ignore-scripts
scripts.build:vscode: npm run build -w @oak-observatory/core && npm run build -w oak-observatory-vscode
scripts.test: npm run version:check && npm run check:privacy && npm run check:webview && npm run build && npm run build:vscode && node --require ./test/bootstrap.cjs --test test/bootstrap.test.js test/cli.test.js test/session-listing-cli.test.js test/gates.test.js packages/core/test/core.test.js packages/core/test/parity.test.js packages/core/test/review.test.js packages/core/test/herdr-install.test.js packages/core/test/herdr-plugin.test.js packages/core/test/herdr-tabs.test.js packages/core/test/herdr.test.js packages/core/test/session-listing.test.js packages/core/test/codex-hook-trust.test.js packages/core/test/conversation.test.js packages/core/test/conversation-perf.test.js packages/core/test/derived-transcript.test.js packages/core/test/codex-herdr-join.test.js packages/core/test/retirement.test.js packages/vscode/test/smoke.test.js packages/tui/test/textwidth.js packages/tui/test/tabs.js packages/tui/test/conversation-backend.js packages/tui/test/review-remote.js packages/tui/test/media.js packages/tui/test/tab-accessor.js packages/tui/test/tree.js packages/tui/test/observatory.js packages/tui/test/daemon.js packages/tui/test/native.js packages/tui/test/first-run.js packages/tui/test/doctor.js
scripts.build:tui: npm run build -w @oak-observatory/core && npm run build -w @oak-observatory/tui
